votes.motion: Commissioner Wendel – I move for approval of the Consent Agenda consisting of the Minutes for May 24, 2022, as presented

Commissioner Wendel - I move to table File #22C22 CUP-000214-2022, the public hearing and consideration of a non-administrative conditional use permit to operate a Class D3 Home Occupation Daycare at 5756 South Player Ridge Circle in Taylorsville, Utah

Commissioner Quigley - I would like to move to approve the conditional use permit for File #6C22, Phase One of the Volta Mixed-use Development, based on the findings stated in the Staff Report , with the following conditions: (1) Minor modifications to the building lighting, building signage, and landscape may be approved by Staff. In addition, (2) the issue of the temporary parking stalls so that they meet the Code for the number of parking stalls, be addressed prior to the Certificate of Occupancy and that would also be delegated to Staff to determine it being completed. Commissioner Wright

Commissioner Quigley I move to approve the subdivision for File #1S22 with the following conditions: (1) The final subdivision plat will receive approval from all applicable reviewing agencies. (2) A Title Report will be submitted to the City prior to the recordation of the plat

Commissioner Wilkey – I move we send a positive recommendation to the City Council for File #4Z22 for an amendment to the Land Development Code, Chapter 13.25.010 Sections C and D related to General Landscaping Standards amended to reflect the changes shown in Exhibit A. Commissioner Wright – May we amend that to include taller plants may be used, just not within the clear view space. Commissioner Wilkey – and to allow plants that exceed 3’ outside of the vision triangle
By motion the meeting was adjourned.
